Dear Daniel,

Please book the cancellation slot you offered for the heating diagnostic at 7 Mallowmere Walk, Larkfen, ZZ1 1ZZ (ref R/014): 15 January, 09:00–11:00.

- Authorised: the fixed £168 (inc. VAT) diagnostic call-out only, under the landlord's urgent-repair authority.
- Fault: radiators cold, boiler display blank, heating controller unresponsive. Hot water still works and there is no gas smell or visible leak.
- Access: please phone Leah Venn directly at least 30 minutes before you arrive, then call her again from outside rather than knocking. She needs extra time to answer the door. Please don't attend unannounced. Nobody else can give access and we hold no key.
- Further work: please send a quote for any parts or remedial work before starting. Additional costs may need the landlord's consent.

Please reply to confirm the booking is secured.

Kind regards,
Donna, Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: Heating failure at 7 Mallowmere Walk (R/014): diagnostic requested under your urgent authority
input.body:
Dear Mr Pike,

Update on the heating failure at 7 Mallowmere Walk, Larkfen, ZZ1 1ZZ (ref R/014).

The living room was down to 10°C at 16:25. As you confirmed on 14 January, we are treating this as an urgent repair. We have asked Brackenridge Heat Services to book a cancellation diagnostic slot for 15 January, 09:00–11:00, at the fixed £168 including VAT. This is within your £250 per-incident urgent-repair authority. We are waiting for them to confirm the booking. Any parts or remedial work will be quoted separately and referred to you if the total goes over £250.

There is one decision for you. The tenant has no safe heater and limited mobility. Our duty manager will contact you about temporary heating (for example, a heater delivery) or transport to a relative tonight. These costs are not covered by the repair authority, so please let us know whether you agree to them.

Kind regards,
Donna, Northbridge Lettings
